model_scope: Original Nintendo Joy-Con HAC-015/HAC-016 paired with Nintendo Switch HAC-001; Joy-Con 2 excluded.

sources.use: Original Switch product page; published front/back/rail-side Joy-Con images
Both front control layouts, glyphs, HOME and capture
SL/SR caps, SYNC, LEDs, stick silhouette
Published total Joy-Con 102 x 35.9 x 28.4 mm; no local button dimensions
Left original Joy-Con Fig.3 front, Fig.4 rear, Fig.5/6 top/bottom, Fig.7 rail side, Fig.8 outer side. Later Fig.9-14 wide-body embodiment excluded from dimensional calibration.

coordinate_basis.warning: Mapping the existing 102 mm model shell to the selected shell edges is a fitting convention. The published overall height includes small projections; the alternate whole-image anchor at y=168-915 changes estimates by up to approximately 0.7 mm. These are not manufacturing dimensions.
coordinate_basis.model_axes: X follows handheld width, Y increases toward the shell top, and Z follows housing depth. Front shell top/bottom use Y=+51/-51 mm; inner shell edges use X=-86.5/+86.5 mm.

round_face_keys.decision: retain 7.6 mm diameter and 7.7 mm radial pitch
round_face_keys.evidence: Existing full-image circle fit is about 7.68 mm; patent Fig. 3 gives about 7.56 mm. There is no stronger evidence for changing the existing dimensions.

ABXY_glyph.method: OpenCV grayscale > 175 within a 35 x 35 pixel centered ROI; A is occluded by a red callout and excluded from this measurement.
ABXY_glyph.alignment: Center the actual glyph bounds on its button center.

direction_triangle.appearance: Dark molded triangle on dark grey face; not white printed arrows

HOME.appearance: Grey cap with a black house symbol and a lighter grey outer ring.

plus_minus.decision: Retain the 5.4 mm plus/minus spans and 1.7/1.75 mm strokes; cap-versus-socket ambiguity exceeds the likely change.
plus_minus.method: Neutral pixels with grayscale < 60 identify the outer dark outline, including socket and shadow. The raised cap boundary lies approximately 1-2 pixels inside. A red annotation crosses the central bar, so there is no fully unobscured cap contour.

stick_cap.decision: Retain the current 15.8 mm cap diameter.
stick_cap.evidence: The patent side cap silhouette measures about 127-129 pixels at 102/864 mm per pixel, suggesting 15.0-15.2 mm. The retail side image suggests about 14.5-15.2 mm depending on edge selection. The front patent outer ring is about 17.1 mm but includes another contour. Different projected surfaces and retail-rendering uncertainty do not support a precise replacement diameter.

rail_controls.cross_section_alignment: SL/SR, SYNC and LED centers lie at image x approximately 726, within 2 pixels. The adopted model puts all centers on the same rail-depth centerline at Z=7.4 mm.

shoulder_trigger_release.decision: Retain current shoulder, rear-trigger and release-button geometry after comparison with Fig. 3/4/5/7.
shoulder_trigger_release.reason: The current shoulder projected extent of 28 mm, trigger span of 24.9 x 13.2 mm, and release cap/hole diameters of 4.7/5.06 mm fall within the broad photograph and patent interpretation. No unambiguous discrepancy supports changing them in this iteration.

limitations: All local dimensions are image estimates, not Nintendo published button dimensions or physical metrology.
Red leader lines obscure parts of A, left arrow, minus, plus, HOME edge and SYNC lower region.
Keep separate cap, bevel, socket/ring, glyph and cast shadow boundaries.
D819642 only directly supplies the left Joy-Con standard embodiment; do not mirror its minus/capture layout to infer right plus/HOME.
Marketing images are near-front, not certified orthographic camera captures. Retain existing dimensions when evidence is ambiguous.
review_notes: Reference URLs, asset hashes and image coordinates are retained; reference photographs and patent page images are not redistributed with this record.
Nintendo source pages and their linked images were checked online; the patent PDF was inspected as complete rendered pages.
record_scope: Public-reference image measurements and adopted modeling values. This record does not certify CAD validity, hardware accuracy or factory equivalence.

image_measurement_uncertainty.interpretation: Approximate uncertainty from pixel edge selection, image scaling and occlusion. This is neither a Nintendo manufacturing tolerance nor a verified bound on error against physical hardware. The scale-anchor ambiguity is recorded separately.
